items.issue: R1: the global BUVIS_AUTO_UPDATE fallback changes the `enabled` decision without changing the settings object passed to the updater, so with a tool-prefixed settings class, BUVIS_AUTO_UPDATE=true and YAML auto_update: false the updater receives settings.auto_update=False and returns immediately. test_global_env_true_runs_tool_check_despite_yaml_false only counts mocked calls, so it pins behaviour production never has. Introduced by the cycle-1 rework (commit a55906ab, src/lib/buvis/pybase/configuration/click_integration.py:210).

items.issue: R3: docs/source/configuration.rst:830 claims a tool-prefixed BUVIS_<TOOL>_AUTO_UPDATE overrides YAML, which is wrong for the `true` direction: ConfigResolver._merge_overrides treats an env value equal to the field default as unset, so YAML false wins. Narrow the sentence to the false direction or make the prefixed branch env-only.

R11: the shared-file unknown-key check does not know other tools settings fields, so a top-level sources: (braid field) warns when sysup resolves config.yaml. PRD Success Metric 1 says any tools settings field; the approved design says shared files carry <tool>: namespace sections instead, and per-tool field sets would make the library import tool code against the AGENTS.md invariant.

items.issue: R2 (cycle 2): resolve() hands the own-field set to _warn_unknown_shared_keys through mutable instance state (self._own_fields) instead of the keyword argument on _load_yaml the task contract specified, so _load_yaml now depends on resolve() having run first. Fix: compute own_fields as a local in resolve(), add own_fields to _load_yaml as a keyword parameter, drop the instance attribute.
